title: An Essay Concerning Human Understanding
author: Various
content:
An Essay Concerning Humane Understanding (1690) First edition
An Essay Concerning Humane Understanding (1694) Second edition. Revised with additions, and one new chapter. IA
An Essay Concerning Humane Understanding (1695) Third edition. IA
An Essay Concerning Humane Understanding (1700) Fourth edition. Revised with additions, and two new chapters. IA
An Essay Concerning Humane Understanding (1706) Fifth edition. Minor revisions; the main additions are footnotes concerning Locke's debate with Edward Stillingfleet, Bishop of Worcester. IA
An Essay Concerning Humane Understanding (1710) Sixth edition. Identical to the fifth edition. IA, IA


=== Later editions ===
An Essay Concerning Human Understanding (1853). Published by Troutman & Hayes. Reprint of the sixth edition.
